enjoy oneself: We enjoyed ourselves very much at the party last night.
我们在昨晚的聚会上玩得非常开心。
May Day: Many families travel to visit relatives during the May Day holiday every year.
每年五一劳动节假期，许多家庭都会走亲访友。
summer holiday: I spent my summer holiday at my grandmother's house in the countryside.
我在乡下的祖母家度过了暑假。
go sightseeing: When we visit a new city, we usually go sightseeing on the first day.
当我们到一座新城市时，通常第一天会去观光。
in the future: Robots will do much more housework for us in the future.
将来机器人会为我们做更多的家务。
not ⋯ any more: He used to live here, but he does not live here any more.
他以前住在这里，但现在不再住了。
traffic jam: We were late for school because we got stuck in a traffic jam.
我们上学迟到了，因为遇上了交通堵塞。
here is/are: Here is the book you asked for yesterday.
bike (=bicycle): My father rides his bike to work every day to keep healthy.
我父亲每天骑自行车上班来保持健康。
not only ⋯ but also ⋯: She is not only good at math but also interested in music.
她不仅擅长数学，而且对音乐感兴趣。
as well: My brother plays football, and he plays basketball as well.
我弟弟踢足球，也打篮球。
Mother's Day: Her children cooked a big dinner for her on Mother's Day.
母亲节那天，她的孩子们为她做了一顿丰盛的晚餐。
wait a minute: Wait a minute, I need to find my keys before we leave.
稍等一下，我们出发前我得找一下钥匙。
one of ⋯⋯: Beijing is one of the largest cities in the world.
北京是世界上最大的城市之一。
one day: One day, people may travel to the moon for holidays.
总有一天，人们可以去月球度假。
Why not ⋯?: Why not join us and play basketball after school?
为什么不放学后加入我们打篮球呢？
metre (AmE meter): The river is about three metres deep in the middle.
这条河中间大约有三米深。
movie theater (BrE theatre): There is a large movie theater near our school with comfortable seats.
我们学校附近有一家座位舒适的大电影院。
once upon a time: Once upon a time, there was an old man who lived by the sea.
从前，有一位老人住在海边。
all alone: The little girl felt all alone in the big empty house.
小女孩在空荡荡的大房子里感到孤零零的。
in pieces: The vase dropped on the floor and lay there in pieces.
花瓶掉在地板上，碎成了一片片。
point at: It is impolite to point at people with your finger when talking.
说话时用手指着别人是不礼貌的。
Women's Day: The company gave every female worker a small gift on Women's Day.
妇女节那天，公司给每位女员工送了一份小礼物。
Children's Day: The students put on a wonderful show for Children's Day.
学生们为儿童节表演了一场精彩的节目。
at the age of: She began to learn the piano at the age of six.
in the 1860s: The railway was built in the 1860s and changed the town forever.
这条铁路建于19世纪60年代，永远改变了这座小镇。
shake hands: People in that country usually shake hands when they meet for the first time.
那个国家的人初次见面时通常会握手。
North American: Many North American students study Chinese at school now.
现在许多北美学生在学校学习中文。
arm in arm: The two old friends walked arm in arm along the quiet street.
两位老朋友臂挽着臂走在安静的街道上。
South American: A famous South American writer came to our university to give a talk.
一位著名的南美作家来我们大学做讲座。
not at all: "Thank you for your help." "Not at all. I am happy to do it."
“多谢你的帮助。”“不客气，我很乐意帮忙。”
pop (=popular): This pop song is so popular that almost everyone can sing it.
这首流行歌曲如此受欢迎，几乎人人都会唱。
centre (AmE center): There is a shopping centre in the middle of the city.
市中心有一座购物中心。
dance music: The old couple danced happily when the band played some dance music.
乐队演奏舞曲时，这对老夫妇开心地跳起舞来。
make a mistake: Don't be afraid to make a mistake when you speak English.
说英语时不要害怕犯错误。
I agree with you that we should start the plan earlier.
我同意你的看法，我们应该早点开始这个计划。
ask for: If you get lost in the city, you can ask for help from the police.
如果你在这座城市迷路了，可以向警察求助。
pretty good: The food in this small restaurant is pretty good and cheap.
这家小餐馆的菜相当好，而且便宜。
home town: My home town is a beautiful village with a clear river.
我的家乡是一个有着清澈河流的美丽村庄。
be famous for: Hangzhou is famous for its beautiful West Lake.
杭州以美丽的西湖而闻名。
